(rule!
  (let* ((ref (first (find-color g 9)))
         (offsets (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first ref)) (- (second p) (second ref))))
                       (find-color g 4)))
         (anchors (find-color g 2)))
    (let* ((painted
            (for/fold ([out (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) anchors 2)])
                      ([anchor (in-list anchors)])
              (for/fold ([acc out]) ([off (in-list offsets)])
                (let ((rr (+ (first anchor) (first off)))
                      (cc (+ (second anchor) (second off))))
                  (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows acc) (cols acc))
                      (set-cell acc rr cc 4)
                      acc))))))
      (paint-cells painted anchors 2))))
